name: Henry Clay Frick House

location.text: 1 East 70th Street, New York, New York

dates.note: The Carrère and Hastings article's list: 'Henry Clay Frick House ... 1913-1914'; the Henry Clay Frick article says 'built in 1913'. Designed by Thomas Hastings after Carrère's death in 1911 (both articles).
